diff:
diff --git a/app/receipt.py b/app/receipt.py
index 83d8233..108c4c1 100644
--- a/app/receipt.py
+++ b/app/receipt.py
@@ -1,2 +1,10 @@
+def format_cents(cents: int) -> str:
+    sign = "-" if cents < 0 else ""
+    euros, rest = divmod(abs(cents), 100)
+    return f"{sign}{euros}.{rest:02d} EUR"
+
+
 def receipt_lines(items: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> list[str]:
-    return [f"{name}: {cents} cents" for name, cents in items]
+    lines = [f"{name}: {format_cents(cents)}" for name, cents in items]
+    total = sum(cents for _, cents in items)
+    return [*lines, f"Total: {format_cents(total)}"]
diff --git a/tests/test_receipt.py b/tests/test_receipt.py
index 26f4bee..514a145 100644
--- a/tests/test_receipt.py
+++ b/tests/test_receipt.py
@@ -1,5 +1,19 @@
-from app.receipt import receipt_lines
+from app.receipt import format_cents, receipt_lines
 
 
-def test_one_line_per_item():
-    assert receipt_lines([("mug", 900), ("tea", 100)]) == ["mug: 900 cents", "tea: 100 cents"]
+def test_one_line_per_item_and_the_total():
+    assert receipt_lines([("mug", 900), ("tea", 105)]) == [
+        "mug: 9.00 EUR",
+        "tea: 1.05 EUR",
+        "Total: 10.05 EUR",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_an_empty_receipt_totals_zero():
+    assert receipt_lines([]) == ["Total: 0.00 EUR"]
+
+
+def test_format_cents_pads_and_signs():
+    assert format_cents(5) == "0.05 EUR"
+    assert format_cents(1234) == "12.34 EUR"
+    assert format_cents(-5) == "-0.05 EUR"

# Review rules

- Never log a secret: an API key, a token or a password.
- Amounts are integer cents, never floating-point numbers.
- A query takes its values as parameters, never built into the SQL text.
